links.outcome: Early keratoconus detection AUC versus baseline CNN and ViT models on same data
links.quote: Comparative benchmarking against baseline CNN and ViT models demonstrated superior diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.95 ± 0.03 vs. 0.88 and 0.90, p < 0.05), confirming the added value of the neuro-symbolic reasoning layer.

unlisted_practices: Neuro-symbolic knowledge graph with Bayesian inference combined with LLM report generation for explainable corneal imaging decision support

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates a neuro-symbolic and LLM-driven explainable decision support framework for corneal topography interpretation, evaluated by expert clinicians for accuracy and report quality.
